All students should read the readings before class every week - and come prepared to discuss the issues raised, or to ask about any aspects of the text that they do not understand.
While reading…
Underline any words or phrases you find difficult to understand – but don’t consult your dictionary until you have finished the section or chapter you are reading. Try to understand the general meaning of the text first, and then go back to check the meaning of any difficult terms.
Note: When reading academic English, you don’t need to learn or memorize every single unknown word. However, words or phrases that occur repeatedly are probably worth remembering and using.

授業科目の成績評価の方法について.備考:
Assessment: At the end of the semester, you will be required to write (in Japanese or English) a review of one of the articles we have read.
Before the end of term, I will show you some examples of book reviews. When reviewing a book or article, you should consider the following questions:
-	What is this book/article about?
-	Who is it written for? (Who is likely to be most interested in reading it?)
-	What argument is it trying to make? What are the main points of the argument?
-	How convincing or reasonable is this argument, and why? What are the strengths and weaknesses of the analysis?

授業科目に関する学習相談について.合理的配慮について:
障害(難病・慢性疾患含む)があり、通常の方法による授業を受けることが困難な場合には、教育目的の本質的な変更など過重な負担を伴わない限り、合理的配慮を受けることができます。合理的配慮とは、教授・学習法の変更、成績評価の方法の変更、授業情報の保障(資料の字幕化、個別の資料配布、録音・撮影の許可)、受講環境の調整などを指します。実際の方法については担当教員と建設的対話を行った上で決定されます。
